summary: Implemented custom global generators loaded by name from <cache>/extensions/generators/<Name>.py (class <Name> required). Built-in generator names take precedence. Changes: conans/client/cache/cache.py (GENERATORS_EXTENSION_FOLDER, ClientCache.generators_path); conans/client/generators/__init__.py (split built-in lookup, added _get_custom_generator_class, optional cache_generators_folder param on _get_generator_class and write_generators, rejects names with path separators); conans/client/installer.py (two write_generators calls pass self._cache.generators_path); conan/api/subapi/install.py (passes app.cache.generators_path). Not run: no tests executed, none added; docs not touched; nothing committed. Naming convention (file and class named after the generator) is a choice to confirm against the docs PR.
